title: Default Mirror Activation shortcut conflicts with non-US keyboard layouts

judgment.rationale: A public fork PR and related long-running issue provide a concrete fix path for the derived-hotkey/AltGr collision.
evidence: Zoomit.cpp derives mirror and recording Ctrl+Alt variants by XOR-ing modifier bits.
Issue discussion provides German and Danish reproductions and explains RegisterHotKey consumption.
Related #37143 documents the same non-US layout class.
Public fork PR mangokingTW/PowerToys#5 contains strict regression tests.
judgment.recommended_action: Track existing fork work and validate upstream suitability; do not duplicate implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The linked public fork PR is a concrete fix/test attempt covering this issue class.

issue_context.summary: ZoomIt derives extra hotkeys from configured modifiers, so a Ctrl+digit assignment also registers Ctrl+Alt+digit. Windows represents AltGr as Ctrl+Alt, consuming bracket entry on German and Danish layouts. A public fork PR contains regression tests.
known_information: AltGr+9 should type ] but activates ZoomIt mirror.
Zoomit.cpp registers mirrorWindowMod as g_MirrorToggleMod XOR MOD_ALT and registers the derived hotkey.
The same derivation exists for recording.
inferences: This is a class-wide derived-hotkey design issue, not a character comparison bug.
issue_context.analysis: Implementation evidence and independent UI-test evidence are strong; link existing work rather than propose a competing plan.
initial_investigation: Read #37143 history documenting the longstanding AltGr/Ctrl+Alt collision.
Read the current issue comment describing automated physical-AltGr reproduction and strict xfails.

existing_fixes.coverage: Tests and investigates AltGr/physical-AltGr collisions caused by derived ZoomIt hotkeys.
Existing upstream issue documenting the same non-US keyboard collision class.

comment.body: This issue is covered by the existing non-US keyboard hotkey investigation and public regression-test fix: #37143 and https://github.com/mangokingTW/PowerToys/pull/5. ZoomIt currently derives Ctrl+Alt variants in Zoomit.cpp, which is the collision mechanism described here.
